acf.speaker_position: Senior Scala Developer at Scala Tooling, VirtusLab

blocks.html: Michał is a Senior Scala Tooling Developer @ VirtusLab with more than 6 years of commercial experience in writing Scala applications. For the last year, he's been a part of the core team responsible for the development of the official Scala 3 compiler in close collaboration with Martin Odersky, EPFL, and Scala Center.
